argv: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; function Run-Proc([string]$file,[string]$args,[int]$ms=6000){;  $psi=New-Object System.Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo; $psi.FileName=$file; $psi.Arguments=$args; $psi.UseShellExecute=$false; $psi.RedirectStandardOutput=$true; $psi.RedirectStandardError=$true; $psi.CreateNoWindow=$true;;  $p=New-Object System.Diagnostics.Process; $p.StartInfo=$psi; [void]$p.Start();;  if(-not $p.WaitForExit($ms)){try{$p.Kill()}catch{}; return @{timeout=$true;rc=$null;out='';err='TIMEOUT'}};;  return @{timeout=$false;rc=$p.ExitCode;out=$p.StandardOutput.ReadToEnd();err=$p.StandardError.ReadToEnd()}; }; $s=Run-Proc 'sc.exe' '\\VOPC5750 query schedule' 6000; Write-Output ('SC_RC='+$s.rc+' TIMEOUT='+$s.timeout); Write-Output $s.out; Write-Output $s.err; $w=Run-Proc 'wmic.exe' '/node:VOPC5750 os get Caption /value' 6000; Write-Output ('WMI_RC='+$w.rc+' TIMEOUT='+$w.timeout); Write-Output $w.out; Write-Output $w.err
